notes.title: Phenomena Embattled v3.02 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Phenomena Embattled v3.02 PATCH NOTES


Bug Fixes:
- The player vehicle should no longer get stuck in the chain holding the submersed 'EAI Deep Sea Habitat' when being pulled out of the cave.
- Hostile skirmishing craft no longer spawn at a fixed location.

Gameplay:
- 'A8-Phantoms' now have formation positions and improved approach tactics.
- Improved damage of 'Rapid Laser'. The ability is now more effective at targeting swarms from afar.

Features:
- Game options and controls can now be changed in-game.
- Separate volume control for sound effects.
- Input indicators now use Controller-Icons to indicate current binding.

notes.title: Phenomena Embattled Demo v3.01 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[b]Phenomena Embattled v3.01 PATCH NOTES[/b]

Bug Fixes:
- Gravitron now draws and animates after selecting the ability in the 'Battle Menu'.
- When saving, any later chapter previously saved will no longer be overwritten.
- After the player loses the game, the player can no longer close the 'In-Game-Menu'.
- When using a gamepad in a Linux-OS, the left trigger will now work.

Gameplay:
- There is a much lower chance of getting hit by lightning when near a weather balloon.
- Waves will now be reinforced when approaching or destroying a weather balloon. 
- The player can no longer omit new waves by not destroying a previous one.
- Waves start earlier in the game at a higher unit count.

notes.title: The new Demo has arrived!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Phenomena Embattled - Demo v3.0[/b][/h2]

[b][i]The update features an entirely new approach to the game. An approach we mean to keep and refine in the coming months. [/i][/b]

Start on a new adventure on Earth. Face off against humanity and clash with forces from beyond the blue marble. The first formation-flight systems are present and the best part is this is the beginning. For the developer this is a milestone in the completion of the main title. It provides the basis for the vision of going up against swarms of coordinated squadrons. The Demo is key in finding a balanced, challenging and adaptable foe to test your skills. 
[b]
The developer means to keep working on v3.x until the main title is ready. We hope you enjoy the early access of Phenomena Embattled as much as we do and make sure to check the Demo out at the Steam Next Fest October 2024![/b]

LightInt

notes.title: Demo v2.0 - Major update!
notes.content:
[b]Demo v2.0 - A new beginning![/b]

It took a long time... and now it is time to enjoy some transmedium combat. The update features new graphics, much new content to explore, a tutorial, and of course a new and better control scheme! Now you have the option of using a controller, or sticking to the traditional WASD setup. Beginners can make use of the 'Easy' difficulty setting to get acquainted with UAP combat. Veterans can already start enhancing their maneuvers with the improved slow-motion [b]Infrared Drive[/b]. This Demo is a step closer to what we want to accomplish for the full-version. We are eager to hear your opinions!
